notes: Travel Mode release: add a shared Today Mode entry across the app. On the itinerary it opens a full-screen travel dashboard using the already-rendered final itinerary as its source, so it stays synchronized with D6-D8 routing. During the trip it auto-selects the current Japan day and determines the next stop from Japan time; before the trip it provides D1-D9 preview. The dashboard shows the next stop, Google Maps navigation, live local weather, visibility, gusts, snowfall and estimated snow depth, parking/navigation hints, hotel/end-of-day information, hard time limits and the next five schedule items.
